'''Julian Czesław Malicki''' (born 2 September 1961) is a Polish [[physicist]], professor of [[medical sciences]] and academic teacher at the [[Poznań University of Medical Sciences]]<ref name="auto">{{Citation |title=Ludzie Nauki |work=nauka.gov.pl |url=https://ludzie.nauka.gov.pl/ln/profiles/854H6AF8lIu}}</ref> and The [[Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań]].<ref name="auto"/> Since 1995 the Director of the Greater Poland Cancer Centre.<ref name="auto1">{{Citation |title=Dyrekcja - Wielkopolskie Centrum Onkologii|work=wco.pl |date=2 July 2015 |url=https://wco.pl/o-nas/dyrekcja/}}</ref>

== Education and research ==
Malicki was born on 2 September 1961.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Julian Czesław Malicki |url=http://www.monitorfirm.pl/Julian-Czeslaw-Malicki |website=monitorfirm.pl |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180227214222/http://www.monitorfirm.pl/Julian-Czeslaw-Malicki |archive-date=27 February 2018}}</ref> He graduated in technical physics from the [[Silesian University of Technology]] in Gliwice, Poland in 1985. In 1992, he obtained his doctoral degree<ref name="auto"/> from the [[Poznań University of Medical Sciences|University of Medical Sciences in Poznań]] (doctoral thesis entitled ''"Model of electromagnetic ionizing radiation dose distributions in a biological object"''). In 1993 he was a fellow of the Council of International Programs at [[Indiana University]] in Indianapolis (USA) ).In 1994, he received a master's degree in law from the [[University of Silesia in Katowice|University of Silesia]] in Katowice, Poland. He obtained his habilitation at the [[Poznań University of Medical Sciences|University of Medical Sciences in Poznań]] in 1999<ref name="auto"/> based on the assessment of his scientific achievements and the thesis entitled ''"Dose distributions and their fractionation in the method of whole-body irradiation before [[Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation|bone marrow transplantation]]"''. He was awarded the academic title of Professor of Medical Sciences in 2009.<ref name="auto"/>

His research interests include, among others, the following: interaction of [[ionizing radiation]] with biological objects; methods of verifying irradiation using in vivo [[dosimetry]] and imaging techniques; whole-body irradiation before bone marrow transplantation; and the standardization of radiotherapy procedures in the European Union. He is also active in field of health care optimisation. His recent research activity is focused on the implementation of international clinical audits in radiation oncology and on influence of individual predisposition on response to ionising radiation.{{citation needed|date=August 2025}}

He has published numerous articles in international journals, including the top journals in the field of radiotherapy and medical physics (Radiotherapy & Oncology, Radiology and Oncology, Physica Medica, Reports of Practical Oncology and Radiotherapy).{{citation needed|date=August 2025}}

== Professional career ==
From 1985 to 1990 he worked as a [[medical physicist]] at the [[Oncology Institute in Gliwice]]. In 1990, he became the head of the Department of Medical Physics at the [[Greater Poland Cancer Centre]]. In 1995, he became the director of the [[Greater Poland Cancer Centre]].<ref name="auto1"/> Since 2004, he has been the head of the Department of Electroradiology,<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.ump.edu.pl/komunikat/konkurs-na-stanowisko-stypendysty-magistranta-w-projekcie-ncn |title=Konkurs na stanowisko stypendysty-magistranta w projekcie NCN - Uniwersytet Medyczny im. Karola Marcinkowskiego w Poznaniu |website=ump.edu.pl}}</ref> and since 2005 the professor at the [[Poznań University of Medical Sciences]].<ref>{{Citation |title=Uniwersytet Medyczny im. Karola Marcinkowskiego w Poznaniu|work=ump.edu.pl |url=https://www.ump.edu.pl/szukaj?query=Julian+Malicki#artykuly |language=pl}}</ref> He is also professor at the Faculty of Physics at [[Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań|Adam Mickiewicz University]].<ref>{{Citation |title=pracownik &#124; Wydział Fizyki|work=edu.pl |url=https://amu.edu.pl/Wydzial-Fizyki/ |language=pl}}</ref> From 2016 to 2020 he was a member of the senate at the [[Poznań University of Medical Sciences|University of Medical Sciences in Poznań]]. He served as National Consultant in Medical Physics from 2016 to 2019.<ref>{{Citation |title=Jest nowy konsultant w dziedzinie fizyki medycznej - MedExpress.pl|work=medexpress.pl |url=https://www.medexpress.pl/ochrona-zdrowia/jest-nowy-konsultant-w-dziedzinie-fizyki-medycznej-74806/ |language=pl}}</ref>

He is a member of several scientific societies, including the Polish Society of Radiation Oncology (vice-president 2003–2013), the European Society of Therapeutic Radiology and Oncology (ESTRO, board member 2003–2005),<ref>{{Citation |title=Past boards of directors |work=www.estro.org |url=https://www.estro.org/About/Hall-of-fame/Past-boards-of-directors}}</ref> the Polish Society of Medical Physics (PSMP),<ref>{{Citation |title=17. Kongres Polskiego Towarzystwa Fizyki Medycznej 2022 (29 September 2022 - 2 October 2022): Komitety (Committees) · Institute of Nuclear Physics Polish Academy of Sciences|work=ifj.edu.pl |url=https://indico.ifj.edu.pl/event/785/page/129-komitety-committees}}</ref> the American Society of Radiation Oncology (ASTRO), Latin American Society of Radiation Oncology (ALATRO), and American Association of Physicists in Medicine (AAPM). He was a member (2004–2007) of the Committee of Medical Physics, Radiobiology, and Diagnostic Imaging of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].

He led a project financed by the [[European Commission]] known as ACCIRAD, whose aim was to develop guidelines for accidental and unintended exposures in radiological practices (2011–2013).<ref>{{Citation |title=ACCIRAD – Guidelines on risk analysis of accidental and unintended exposures in radiotherapy – projekt Wielkopolskiego Centrum Onkologii finansowany ze środków Komisji|work=wco.pl |date=10 December 2011 |url=https://wco.pl/2011/12/10/accirad-guidelines-on-risk-analysis-of-accidental-and-unintended-exposures-in-radiotherapy-projekt-wielkopolskiego-centrum-onkologii-finansowany-ze-srodkow-komisji-europejskiej/}}</ref> He was a member (2008–2014) of the ESTRO working group "Health Economics in Radiation Oncology (HERO)",<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Lievens |first1=Yolande |last2=Grau |first2=Cai |title=Health Economics in Radiation Oncology: Introducing the ESTRO HERO project |journal=Radiotherapy and Oncology |date=April 2012 |volume=103 |issue=1 |pages=109–112 |doi=10.1016/j.radonc.2011.12.026 |pmid=22325993 |doi-access=free }}</ref> a project to determine cancer incidence and staging, radiotherapy utilisation rates, and staffing and equipment levels in European countries. Since 2014, he has co-led the multicentre, international IROCA (Improving Radiation Oncology through Clinical Audits) project.<ref>{{Cite journal |title=Improving radiation oncology through clinical audits: Introducing the IROCA project |first1=Maria Glòria |last1=Torras |first2=Magdalena |last2=Fundowicz |first3=Luisa |last3=Aliste |first4=Esther |last4=Asensio |first5=Anna Maria |last5=Boladeras |first6=Josep Maria |last6=Borràs |first7=Luísa |last7=Carvalho |first8=Carla |last8=Castro |first9=Letizia |last9=Deantonio|first10=Ewelina|last10=Konstanty |first11=Marco |last11=Krengli |first12=Marta |last12=Kruszyna |first13=Joana |last13=Lencart |first14=Miquel |last14=Macià |first15=Susanna |last15=Marín |first16=Carles |last16=Muñoz-Montplet |first17=Carla |last17=Pisani |first18=Diana |last18=Pinto |first19=Montserrat |last19=Puigdemont|first20=Ferran|last20=Guedea |first21=Artur |last21=Aguiar |first22=Piotr |last22=Milecki |first23=Julian |last23=Malicki |date=September 1, 2017 |journal=Reports of Practical Oncology & Radiotherapy |volume=22 |issue=5 |pages=408–414 |doi=10.1016/j.rpor.2017.07.004 |pmid=28831281 |pmc=5554963}}{{primary source inline|date=August 2025}}</ref>

Since 1996, he has been the editor-in-chief of the scientific journal Reports of Practical Oncology and Radiotherapy.<ref>{{Citation |title=Editorial Board Members|work=viamedica.pl |url=https://journals.viamedica.pl/rpor/about/editorialTeam}}</ref> He is a member of the scientific council of the Letters in Oncology Science<ref>{{Citation |title=Editorial Team &#124; Letters in Oncology Science|work=wco.pl |url=https://journals.wco.pl/los/about/editorialTeam}}</ref> (previously editor-in-chief). He was a member of the board of the journal Physica Medica from 2007 to 2015. Since 1997, he has been a member of the scientific council of the journal Contemporary Oncology<ref>{{Citation |title=Contemporary Oncology - Editorial board|work=termedia.pl |url=https://www.termedia.pl/Journal/Wspolczesna_Onkologia-3/Board |language=pl}}</ref>
